note: NGPC recreation area on Gallagher Canyon Reservoir, an irrigation lake whose level can drop in late summer, SE of Cozad (Dr. 752 off Rd 422). About 30 primitive sites without electricity on dirt tracks across the wooded peninsula west of the dam; first-come first-served year-round. Primitive restrooms; no drinking water, showers or dump station. --Claude
summary: NGPC page (snippets) confirms 30 non-electric primitive sites, FCFS year-round, primitive restrooms, no water/showers/dump; grid row 'B P' keeps $10-15. Not on RA. Imagery is dark and canopy-heavy: no per-site map or shoreline confirmation -> lakefront downgraded to lakeview. Phone 308-785-2685 missing.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade, unsure): no per-site map or reservation data exists (FCFS, not on RA, NGPC page blocked) and the Esri tiles here are dark and low-contrast. The camping is dirt spurs on the wooded peninsula SW of the dam (~40.7340-40.7355, -99.9800 to -99.9775); some spurs run toward the west shore, where the bank shows as a sandy bluff, and one turnaround at the peninsula tip (~40.7339,-99.9773) is within ~20 m of the water, but no source confirms shoreline sites. It is also an irrigation reservoir drawn down in late summer. If an NGPC map or dated photos show shoreline pads, back to lakefront.
PHONE missing: 308-785-2685 (NGPC 2025 rates grid, Gallagher Canyon row). Website is right (blocked, read by snippet only).

FEES left alone: grid row 'Gallagher Canyon' B P (basic $15 / primitive $10; $5 less off-season for basic). The NGPC page describes only primitive camping, so the $15 basic tier may be nominal; base $10 primitive.
FIT for a 23-ft rig: not stated; dirt spurs under trees; no length posted by NGPC. Keep (silent).
PIN 40.73580,-99.97660 sits at the boat ramp/dam road, ~100-250 m from the camping spurs; under the move threshold for most of the area, no move.
SAND: the access is dirt/gravel tracks, not sand or beach; not a sand-rule candidate on what is visible.
